description:
This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and market research purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to isse a RFP in the future.

The USG seeks industry input to refine the attached Appendix A for Shuttle Transportation of Soldiers and address any industry concerns. Interested vendors: please provide a Rough Order of Magnitude to help gauge potential costs. Please see attached Appendix A for details.

This request is for multiple OCONUS locations: Ansbach - Grafenwohr - Baumholder - Honenfels - Kaiserslautem -Wiesbaden - Benelux - Italy - Stuggart - Humphreys/Daegu - Camp Zama - Wainwright - Alaska - Korea - Japan
